system.description:
Beginning at 6th level, your refined eye for anatomy allows you to analyze a targets physiology in real time, striking with uncanny precision, compromising a foes defense with surgical efficiency.

When you deal Lethal Attack damage, you may choose to forgo 1 or 2 Lethal Attack dice.

If you forgo 1 Lethal Attack dice, the damaged creature gains 1 rank of Weakened.

If you forgo 2 Lethal Attack dice, the damaged creature makes their next saving throw against a creature other than yourself at disadvantage, before the beginning of your next turn.

source.custom: Imported full source rules; contextual benefits require adjudication.

activities.label: Lethal Attack (forgo 1)
activities.text: Once per turn, on a hit with advantage or with an ally within 5 feet of the target.

activities.label: Lethal Attack (forgo 1): Attack action or weapon
activities.text: An attack of the Attack action or a weapon attack: half the dice, rounded up (minimum 1).

activities.label: Lethal Attack (forgo 2)
activities.text: Once per turn, on a hit with advantage or with an ally within 5 feet of the target.

activities.label: Lethal Attack (forgo 2): Attack action or weapon
activities.text: An attack of the Attack action or a weapon attack: half the dice, rounded up (minimum 1).

activities.label: Anatomical Studies: next save
activities.text: Forgo 2: its next save against a creature other than you, before the start of your next turn, is at disadvantage.
